valley_of_trials.what: directions on 15 accept lines, place names on explore objectives, 13 greetings rewritten (who / where / what, and true about the camp's forge and sawmill)

echo_isles.what: directions on 4 accept lines, place names on explore objectives, 16 greetings rewritten; coral 75%, crabs only in the Tidal Flats

durotar.what: Old Redtooth moved from the Rocktusk Farm table (146 tiles from where his quest sends you) to the ground below Thunder Ridge; 2 accept lines; 15 greetings rewritten. Prose left alone.

razor_hill.what: 21 greetings rewritten - a sentry at the town's only gate (south) was telling players to watch the north road. No direction findings.

deathknell.what: 4 accept lines given directions; explore objectives named; 12 greetings rewritten (true about Deathknell having a sawmill and no forge). Prose left alone.

tirisfal.what: 2 accept lines (the fisher's strand is south-east of him, not north-west); 38 greetings rewritten across Brill and both Tirisfals - the worst zone for portentous one-liners. Prose left alone.

central_barrens.what: 1 accept line (Ratchet's bandits are at Raider's Rest Oasis, not Grol'dom Farm); greetings for Crossroads (21), Ratchet (20) and the Central Barrens (10).

central_barrens_hub.what: 3 accept lines (the Warbringer; two Wailing Caverns quests now say where the cave is).

southern_barrens.what: greetings for Camp Taurajo (20, written to the canon that Thunder Bluff fell and the tribes look to this camp) and the Southern Barrens (15).

crossroads.what: NEW FILE. The town gave no quests; it now gives 17 across ten NPCs: 12 new (five errands out to the field wardens, three that leave the zone, the envoy's survey, a goblin's fetch, and a two-part capstone gated on three separate boss chains that ends at Camp Taurajo) and 5 moved in from Camp Taurajo.

northern_barrens.what: Five quests given from Camp Taurajo for places two maps north of it moved to Crossroads NPCs and rewritten; the carver's quest re-worded; a Ratchet raptor quest moved to Camp Taurajo's hunter.

southern_barrens_hub.what: Eleven accept lines pointed the wrong way or named no place: Oggra now says Blackthorn Ridge is north of her post and Razorfen Kraul south of it, and Zhuul says the Keep is west of his grass with its east gate facing him. Greetings were done with the Barrens pass.

orgrimmar.what: Seven Ragefire Chasm quests never said where the chasm is; each now names it and its entrance in the south-west corner of the city. 45 greetings rewritten: who, which quarter, what they do, checked against the map. All twelve quests here are dungeon quests given in town, which is the rule.

sepulcher.what: Four quests sent you south to Raven Hill and the Farthing, which are north of the gate, and one north to an orchard that is south. The tour and the stone-reading now use the keep's real place names. 18 greetings. The audit could not see this town before: its map is "The Sepulcher" and its quests say "sepulcher".

silverpine_north.what: The Trunk Road walk said north from a gate at the north edge; it runs south. Eleven places named. 14 greetings.

silverpine_south.what: Eleven places named; the road to Hillsbrad is south-east past the Wall, not south past the pyre. 24 greetings, checked against the map (the south has a sawmill and no forge).

fenris_isle.what: Spine road points north and its stops are named. 6 greetings.

silverpine_dungeons.what: Four quests for Ambermill Tower and Shadowfang Keep never said which dungeon or where its door is. Ten places inside the three dungeons named.

undercity.what: Nine Plague Depths quests named a wing of a dungeon without naming the dungeon or its door (the iron door at the south end of the wheel). A scroll went "by portal into Silverpine": there is no such portal; the way is up the shaft and through the Rear Guard. Six places named. 49 greetings.

ashenvale.what: Twelve quests named no place and gave no direction (the Demon Wastes, Twilight Barrow, Ragged Highlands, Satyr's Throne, Moonwhisper Grove, the Night Run); each now ends by saying where. The Quota sent you east for bears that are north-west. Twelve hand-ins opened with a count, seven of them the wrong one; none do now. Five places named. 45 greetings: Astranaar 15, Splintertree 16, Zoram Strand 11, the woods 3.

ashenvale_dungeons.what: Nine quests for Moonwell Hollow, the Howling Barrows and Grom's Rest said which room and not where the dungeon is.

hillsbrad.what: Two Southpoint quests never said where the Fields are; the bridge errand had three compass words and none for the errand itself; the Wall was "along the top of Hillsbrad" and is in its south-east corner. Twelve places named. 43 greetings: these were already the best in the game, so each keeps its line and gains a name, a place and a bearing.

hillsbrad_dungeons.what: Three quests for Durnholde Keep and Dun Garok named a room and not the dungeon or where it is. One place named.

aspen.what: Wolves were "on the north side" and are on Blackneedle Rise, east. Two quests never named the Weeping Ice or said it is north-east of camp. Seven places named. The 11 greetings here were written to the standard already and are left as they are.

southern_needles.what: Nine quests sent you off the ramp without saying which way: Saltwatch and Dryhollow are south, Broadback and the Drowning Floor west, the Seam north-west, the Anvil at the far west end. The potter had her clay east; it is south. Six places named. Eight generic trainer and banker lines in Freewind Post rewritten; the other 23 greetings there were already good.

stranglethorn_north.what: Six Grom'gol quests named no place: Zul'Marosh Steps and the Green Cut are east, Rotvine Fen far east, Mistvale Lagoon south. Nine places named from the map. Grom'gol's 15 greetings are short one-liners in good voice - not yet lengthened to say who and where.

stranglethorn_central.what: No direction findings. Sixteen places named from the map. Six field greetings are short one-liners - not yet lengthened.

stranglethorn_south.what: The Bloodsail Shallows are east of Booty Bay, not south; Zul'Kundaraz is north-east. Nineteen places named from the map. Booty Bay's 17 greetings are short one-liners - not yet lengthened; the Artifact Keeper's duplicate line rewritten.

arathi.what: Twelve quests: Witherbark Hollow is north-east, not west; Stromgarde south-west of the Pointe; Boulderfist Hall west of Hammerfall and Drywhisker Deeps south-east of it; Gallowmast east of the Landing. 23 places named. Greetings here were written to the standard when the zone was built and are left as they are.

underdark.what: Two quests now say where the Dim Reaches, the Geode and the Bloom are. Eight places named. Greetings here were written to the standard when the zone was built and are left as they are.

underdark_dungeons.what: Five boss quests named a room and not the Hollow Geode (east of the Bastion) or the Deep Bloom (south-west).

shimmering_flats.what: Three quests: the Crust is south-west of Saltwheel, the Mounds east, the Undercrust far south. Thirteen places named. Greetings here were written to the standard when the zone was built and are left as they are.

glittervein.what: Two quests: the Dry Rim is north; the two seams are north-east and south-west. Eleven places named. Greetings here were written to the standard when the zone was built and are left as they are.
